Grok Bot gives you AI teammates that can use your tools, talk to each other, and keep work moving while you are away. 

In this full course, I build a Grok Bot team from scratch using my four Cs framework: context, connections, capabilities, and cadence. You will see agents handle email, ClickUp, content creation, meeting transcripts, Slack routines, bot templates, and more, plus how you could package GrokBot setup as a service.

comments.text:
I'm building this type of solution for my highly specific data verification processes, but I use the Grok - Gemini - Grok method + SecondBrain, because two different models produce way better data analytics results in this type of use. One specific AI model is good in some areas, but two different models will produce higher quality output. Grok for coding and being the brain, giving tasks to Gemini and then verifying those results again. This creates an insane level of verification when instructed correctly.

I wish there was this type of Grok Bot solution where users could automatically run workers that always verify things with workers that run different models. My entire method is to remove complexity in every step. Self-made solutions are almost always too complex and impossible to sell. I only sell the end product, so my method is good enough for now. I feel like even with all the AI help, I don't have enough time to learn new methods + keep updating + testing all the tools.
